{{Quote|The plan's been compromised! The shuttle's not coming!|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="Counterattack">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>}}
'''Class Type B escort shuttles''' were [[Transport/Legends|transports]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At least [[Shuttle 81572/Legends|one]] Type B shuttle was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The vessel had a similar design to the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], but was greater in length.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swa-2011" /> [[Shuttle 81572/Legends|Shuttle 81572]], a Class Type B escort [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], was used by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] elite team led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] officers [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to liberate [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who was being held captive in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].<ref name="tc" /> Though the mission was successful, the shuttle was destroyed in the attempt by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="tc" />

[[File:DookusTypeBShuttle-CoN.png|thumb|left|200px|Dooku's Type B escort shuttle.]]
A Class type B shuttle was used on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], and Obi-Wan Kenobi posing as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] in an attempt to capture [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. However, Dooku used the bounty hunters as a diversion to distract Republic troops, while he lured Anakin and Palpatine to the dinner room. Although Anakin foiled the plot, Dooku used the shuttle to escape from Naboo once more.<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>
